node.title: Re: put a newline character after every four lines in a file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
With a oneliner:

$ perl -i -ple '$_.="\n" if $. % 4 == 0; close ARGV if eof' -- FILES

Documentation: Command-line switches in [doc://perlrun], [doc://$.] for the current line number, [doc://eof] in regards to resetting $., and [doc://perlop#Multiplicative-Operators] for the modulo operator.
